description: Checkpoint and witness runner cases. Each case runs its steps in order against a fresh, empty backend with the case's runner configuration. Times and bytes use the backend contract's portable encodings; loadCll results are in its portable state form, with witnesses sorted by checkpointSize then witnessId and every lastError replaced by "<set>".

capabilities.bounded-run: a checkpoint pass scans one batch of scanLimit entries and checkpoints it when due
capabilities.chain-order: a checkpoint is released to a witness only once the witness's row for its prev_size has a receipt, or when it has no such row
capabilities.stop-after-retryable: a retryable failure ends that witness's delivery pass

cases.name: checkpoint/empty-log
cases.description: A pass over an empty log commits nothing.

cases.name: checkpoint/entry-cadence
cases.description: Entries are indexed as they arrive; a checkpoint is signed once cadenceEntries are uncheckpointed, queues one row per witness, and the next checkpoint carries a consistency proof from the previous one.

cases.name: checkpoint/age-cadence
cases.description: A checkpoint is signed once the oldest uncheckpointed entry has waited cadenceAgeMs, also by a pass that scans no new entry.

cases.name: checkpoint/bounded-batches
cases.description: Each pass scans at most scanLimit entries and checkpoints that batch when it is due.

cases.name: witness/delivery
cases.description: Witnesses are delivered independently: a verified receipt completes a row, a retryable failure backs off from baseBackoffMs, and a permanent failure stops the row.

cases.name: witness/rejected-receipt
cases.description: A receipt that fails verification makes the row permanent.

cases.name: witness/backoff
cases.description: The retry delay doubles per earlier attempt and stops at maxBackoffMs.

cases.name: witness/stop-after-retryable
cases.description: Rows of one witness are delivered in checkpoint order, and a retryable failure ends that witness's pass.

cases.name: witness/chain-order-held
cases.description: A checkpoint is not sent to a witness while that witness's row for its prev_size has no receipt, even when the checkpoint's own row is due and the predecessor's retry is not; once the predecessor succeeds, both are delivered in order.

cases.name: witness/chain-order-permanent
cases.description: A permanent row holds every later checkpoint for that witness and never sends them, while the other witnesses are delivered in order.

cases.name: witness/chain-order-no-predecessor-row
cases.description: A witness with no row for a checkpoint's prev_size (it was added after that checkpoint) is sent the checkpoint, and its own answer decides; the witness that has the predecessor row is delivered in order.

cases.name: witness/chain-order-no-predecessor-row-refused
cases.description: A witness with no row for a checkpoint's prev_size is sent the checkpoint, and its refusal decides: the row becomes permanent with no receipt, while the other witness is delivered in order.

cases.name: witness/chain-order-limit-per-witness
cases.description: A delivery pass reads at most limit due rows per witness: a witness whose due rows are all held behind a permanent row does not use up the page of the others.
